svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print flat in TPU 95A, 0.8 mm thick (four 0.2 mm layers).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It squeezes to 0.5 mm when the lid screws are tight.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Outline the same as the pod: 30 x 40, corners R3.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Opening 27 x 28.6, the same as the base cavity.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 2.2 mm holes at the screw positions (13 and 17.4 each side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of centre) so the screws pass without tearing it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: lies on the base rim, inside edge flush with the cavity wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it lies flat with no stringing across the opening;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: print a spare, since the gasket is replaced if the pod is opened.
